

`internal/mdblocks/write.go`: `Write([]model.EditorBlock) ([]byte, error)`
emits the stored spelling: one line per paragraph and list item, never
wrapped; nested children indented two spaces under their list item; blank
line between blocks except between list items of one list; `source` emits
`props.markdown` verbatim; `callout` emits the fence; a heading with
`anchor` emits `{#anchor}`. `Normalize(md []byte) []byte` is
`Write(Parse(md))`.

The spec's check: `Normalize(Normalize(x)) == Normalize(x)` for every body in
a corpus fixture. Build the fixture once in this task:
`internal/mdblocks/testdata/corpus/` holds the bodies of every accepted rule
and 50 task bodies exported from the dev instance with `lode rule list
--json` and `lode task list --status all --json` (bodies only, one file
each, no identifiers beyond the file name). Record the export date in
`corpus/README`.

```go
func TestCorpusRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
    files, _ := filepath.Glob("testdata/corpus/*.md")
    if len(files) == 0 { t.Fatal("corpus fixture missing") }
    for _, f := range files {
        src, _ := os.ReadFile(f)
        once := mdblocks.Normalize(src)
        twice := mdblocks.Normalize(once)
        if !bytes.Equal(once, twice) {
            t.Errorf("%s: second round trip differs:\n%s", f, cmp.Diff(string(once), string(twice)))
        }
    }
}
```
